paper.title: AutoAgent: Evolving Cognition and Elastic Memory Orchestration for Adaptive Agents
paper.central_claim: 显式认知文本经轨迹反馈演化，配合弹性记忆与组合技能，持续提升工具选择、协作鲁棒性与效率。

provenance.notes: 按当前调用配置执行 sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无独立后端回执与会话凭据，不探测模型。

evidence.quote: Evolution here is not about retraining the underlying LLM’s parameters, but about systematically updating the structured, prompt-level descriptions that constitute the agent’s actionable knowledge
evidence.support_explanation: 非权重描述是留存对象

evidence.quote: A dedicated LLM-based analyzer compares what the agent aimed to achieve (the intention) with what actually occurred (the outcome).
evidence.support_explanation: 意图与结果诊断驱动局部文本更新

evidence.quote: These proposed updates—framed as revisions to descriptive text—are validated (e.g., for consistency) before being integrated into the respective cognition store.
evidence.support_explanation: 一致性门控仅举例，没有可重建验收规则
raw/summary/omit动态组装保留细节访问，具体算法未给

evidence.quote: At runtime, this composite action becomes available in the agent’s action space.
evidence.support_explanation: 组合经验被注册供后续调用，但无单独技能收益消融

evidence.quote: All reported results are based on a single run per task instance under this standardized configuration.

evidence.support_explanation: GAIA/HLE使用o3-mini判断，没有标注审计或验证器一致性

evidence.quote: we design a controlled perturbation experiment on the first 50 GAIA questions.
evidence.support_explanation: 50题同描述动作，注入50%失败，前后比较

evidence.quote: For web search, F1 improves from 24.07% to 29.67% (+5.60), and EM increases from 22.00% to 28.00% (+6.00).
evidence.support_explanation: 有限扰动条件的描述更新收益

evidence.quote: On DeepSeek-R1, it achieves a high success rate of 91.0%, slightly below ReAct’s 94.0%
evidence.support_explanation: 并非所有基准/模型优于基线

evidence.quote: These methods—including iterative self-evolution—remain largely episodic and task-specific
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对Reflexion/Voyager等的区分尚未独立核实
